output.summary: A user on long-term warfarin asked whether methotrexate, proposed by their GP for rheumatoid arthritis, is safe alongside it. They also asked whether it behaves like antibiotics did, which had destabilised their warfarin. The user ended feeling more reassured and with questions to take to the GP.
